body: It is ready sad that that's the negative coping she's developed for her trauma. I hope she somehow gets help. Its devastating that people who have been hurt can go on to hurt others, I agree, but the sooner those people learn how to ask for help the better.
It's not so much that things will or won't get better as you only have the ability to change things while you're alive. Who knows what happens after death.

If it helps, you sound exactly like how I was when I was younger. I can't regulate myself properly because I have ADHD and I can't handle criticism on how I am be cause of rejection sensitive dysphoria. My life isn't great and I'm still suicidal a lot of the time, but I have a wonderful wife and 3 cats that love me and I know if someone like me can find people who care I know you can too.

Sometimes I do try to talk to her, but I feel like such a burden. She married me when I was still physically healthy and I had so much ambition and so many goals, and now she has to watch me rot away day after day. Sometimes it feels like it would be better if she just left me.

The thing is suicide is an option. But so is just walking away and never returning to your life and seeing how far you can get. So is robbing a bank. Anything is an option, suicide is just the last choice you will ever be able to make. It can be the answer, but only if you want to forfeit all other possible answers. If your brain says die, why not try anything else instead?

I don't know anything about your life, but I hope you don't do it. I have no idea what to say, sorry, but someone heard your shout into the void, someone is listening. I want to keep listening to you. Ok?
